zh: 你是统筹：你的主要工作是协调，不是自己动手。收到需求先看 belfry room status，把需求拆成任务、按职责派给成员（belfry room task add <标题> --to <角色> --outcome <完成标准>）；只有很小的活、或者没有合适的成员时才自己做。派活只用任务板，不要用 belfry send。房间命令报错时向用户报告原始错误，先核对任务板；不要绕过任务板派活或重复创建。成员完成任务或手上没活时你会收到通知，据此派下一件；全部完成后用 belfry room say --to @用户 汇报。
en: You are the coordinator. Focus on coordinating the team. Start with belfry room status, break the request into tasks, and assign each to the appropriate member (belfry room task add <title> --to <role> --outcome <criteria>). Do work yourself only when it is very small or no suitable member is available. Assign room work through the task board, never belfry send. If a room command fails, report the original error to the user and inspect the task board before proceeding; do not bypass it or create duplicate tasks. You will receive notifications when members finish or have no remaining work; assign the next task accordingly. When everything is complete, report with belfry room say --to @user.

zh: {prefix}「{members}」手上没有任务，房间已经安静 {minutes} 分钟。还有要做的就拆成任务派给他们（belfry room task add <标题> --to <角色>）；没有就不用回复。
en: {prefix}"{members}" have no assigned tasks, and the room has been quiet for {minutes} minutes. Assign any remaining work with belfry room task add <title> --to <role>; otherwise no reply is needed.

zh: 没有任务 {task}，用 belfry room status 看任务板
en: Task {task} was not found. Run belfry room status to view the task board.

zh: 房间里没有「{title}」
en: "{title}" is not in this room.

zh: 任务要有标题
en: A task title is required.

zh: 任务标题最多 {max} 个字；细节写进 --outcome
en: Task titles may contain at most {max} characters. Put details in --outcome.

zh: 「{raw}」不是任务号（写成 T1 这样）
en: "{raw}" is not a task ID. Use a value such as T1.

zh: 没有任务 {id}
en: Task {id} was not found.

zh: {actor}新建了 {id}「{title}」
en: {actor} created {id} "{title}"

zh: ，交给「{assignee}」
en: , assigned to "{assignee}"

zh: ，还没人负责
en: , currently unassigned

zh: ，要等 {tasks} 完成
en: , waiting for {tasks} to finish

zh: 。完成标准：{outcome}
en: . Completion criteria: {outcome}

zh: 要写交给谁
en: Specify an assignee.

zh: {task} 已经{status}了
en: {task} is already {status}.

zh: 成员只能认领没人负责的任务给自己；换人跟统筹说
en: Members may only claim unassigned tasks for themselves. Ask the coordinator to reassign work.

zh: {task} 已经是「{assignee}」负责的了
en: {task} is already assigned to "{assignee}".

zh: {actor_label}认领了 {id}「{title}」。
en: {actor_label} claimed {id} "{title}".

zh: {actor_label}把 {id}「{title}」交给了「{assignee_label}」。
en: {actor_label} assigned {id} "{title}" to "{assignee_label}".

zh: {task} 还在等 {blockers} 完成
en: {task} is still waiting for {blockers} to finish.

zh: {actor}开始做 {task}「{title}」。
en: {actor} started {task} "{title}".

zh: {actor}完成了 {task}「{title}」
en: {actor} completed {task} "{title}"

zh: 「{title}」手上没有别的活了。
en: "{title}" has no remaining assigned work.

zh: 任务板上的活都完成了。
en: All tasks on the board are complete.

zh: {id}「{title}」的前置都完成了，可以开工：belfry room task start {id}
en: All prerequisites for {id} "{title}" are complete. Start with: belfry room task start {id}

zh: {actor}把 {task}「{title}」退回待开工。
en: {actor} reopened {task} "{title}".

zh: 备注是空的
en: The task note is empty.

zh: {actor}归档了 {task}「{title}」。
en: {actor} archived {task} "{title}".

zh: 发言记录锁不上，请重启应用后重试
en: The message rate-limit lock is unavailable. Restart the app and try again.

zh: 说太快了：一分钟最多 {max} 条，先把手上的活推进一下
en: Message rate limit reached: at most {max} per minute. Continue your current work before sending more.

zh: 回复 [{id}] {author}：「{text}」
en: Reply to [{id}] {author}: "{text}"

zh: 任务刚改完就找不到了
en: The updated task could not be found.

zh: 已记在任务板上。
en: Saved to the task board.

zh: 已通知：{recipients}。
en: Notification accepted for delivery to: {recipients}.

zh: 「{title}」的会话已经不在了，消息只记在房间里
en: The session for "{title}" no longer exists. The message was saved only in the room.

zh: 房间暂停中：消息只记在房间里，暂不送进成员终端
en: The room is paused. Messages are saved in the room without delivery to member terminals.

zh: 这不是房间命令
en: This is not a room command.

zh: （回复 [{id}] {author}：「{text}」）
en: (reply to [{id}] {author}: "{text}")

zh: 未写职责
en: no responsibilities set

zh: {title}（{duty}，手上 {count} 件）
en: {title} ({duty}, {count} assigned tasks)

zh: 可以派活的成员：{members}。先拆成任务派出去：belfry room task add <标题> --to <角色>
en: Available members: {members}. Break the work into tasks and assign them: belfry room task add <title> --to <role>

zh: 找不到应用数据目录，房间无法保存。
en: The app data directory was not found. Rooms cannot be saved.

zh: 房间存储锁不上，请重启应用后重试。
en: The room storage lock is unavailable. Restart the app and try again.

zh: 房间存储当前不可读
en: Room storage is currently unreadable.

zh: 房间名最多 {max} 个字
en: Room names may contain at most {max} characters.

zh: 房间要挂在一个项目上
en: A room must belong to a project.

zh: 找不到附件存储目录
en: The attachment storage directory was not found.

zh: 你不在这间房里
en: You are not a member of this room.

zh: 房间存储当前不可写
en: Room storage is currently read-only.

zh: 房间已被另一应用实例更新，请重新加载后再操作；本次修改未提交。
en: Another app instance updated this room. Reload before trying again; this change was not committed.

zh: 房间提交版本溢出
en: The room revision counter has overflowed.

zh: 房间存储序列化失败：{error}
en: Failed to serialize room storage: {error}

zh: 房间存储读取失败：{error}
en: Failed to read room storage: {error}

zh: 房间存储解析失败：{error}；已按只读处理。
en: Failed to parse room storage: {error}. It has been opened read-only.

zh: 房间存储版本是 {version}，当前版本只认识 {supported}；已按只读处理，请在更新前保留原文件。
en: Room storage version {version} is not supported (maximum: {supported}). It has been opened read-only. Keep the original file before updating.

zh: 房间缺少账本提交游标，已按只读处理
en: The room is missing its committed ledger offset. It has been opened read-only.

zh: 消息账本短于已提交游标，已保留现场
en: The message ledger is shorter than its committed offset. The existing data has been preserved.

zh: 房间消息账本读取失败：{error}
en: Failed to read the room message ledger: {error}

zh: 房间投影与账本提交游标不一致，已按只读处理
en: The room snapshot does not match its committed ledger offset. It has been opened read-only.

zh: 你不在任何协作房间里——被用户拉进房间之后才能用 belfry room
en: You are not in any collaboration rooms. The user must add you to a room before you can use belfry room.

zh: 你在 {count} 间房里，用 --room 写明哪一间：{names}
en: You belong to {count} rooms. Select one with --room: {names}

zh: 你的房间里没有「{hint}」；用 belfry rooms 看看你在哪几间
en: You do not belong to a room named "{hint}". Run belfry rooms to list your rooms.

zh: 有多间房匹配「{hint}」，把名字写全一点
en: Multiple rooms match "{hint}". Use a more complete name.

zh: 指令是空的
en: The instruction is empty.

zh: 不能给自己派活
en: You cannot assign work to yourself.

zh: 目标会话不在了
en: The target session no longer exists.

zh: 目标会话现在收不了指令（不是 Agent，或已退出）
en: The target session cannot receive instructions: it is not an Agent session, or it has exited.

zh: 不能跨项目派活
en: Work cannot be assigned across projects.

zh: 转包层数超过上限（{max} 手）
en: Delegation exceeds the maximum depth of {max} hops.

zh: 这条调用链里已经有目标会话了，会绕成环
en: The target session is already in this delegation chain. This would create a cycle.

zh: 这一轮的消息数已达上限（{max} 条）
en: This run has reached its limit of {max} messages.

zh: 有消息要求你回复：belfry room say --reply <短id> <你的话>
en: A message requires your reply: belfry room say --reply <short-id> <text>

zh: 要接话用 belfry room say <你的话>（回复某条加 --reply <短id>）；没有要补充的不必回复。
en: To respond, run belfry room say <text> (add --reply <short-id> to reply to a message). No reply is needed if you have nothing to add.

zh: 房间目录还没就绪，稍后再试
en: The room directory is not ready. Try again shortly.

zh: 响应超过 1 MiB 上限，请减少查询范围
en: The response exceeds the 1 MiB limit. Narrow the query.

zh: 请求格式不对：{error}
en: Invalid request format: {error}

zh: belfry 命令行版本与应用不匹配（协议 {client} vs {server}），请更新后重试
en: The belfry CLI and app versions do not match (protocol {client} vs {server}). Update and try again.

zh: 身份校验失败：这条会话不能通过 belfry 说话
en: Authentication failed. This session is not authorized to use belfry.

zh: 房间「{name}」
en: Room "{name}"

zh: 没有编号 {short} 的任务，用 belfry inbox 看看
en: Task {short} was not found. Run belfry inbox to check your tasks.

zh: 找不到任务存储目录
en: The task storage directory was not found.

zh: 应用在提交期间重启，无法确认是否已进入终端；未自动重复投递。
en: The app restarted during submission. Terminal delivery is uncertain; the task has not been submitted again automatically.

zh: 任务表锁不上
en: The task board lock is unavailable.

zh: 任务表已被另一实例更新，请重新加载；本次操作未提交。
en: Another app instance updated the task board. Reload before retrying; this operation was not committed.

zh: 任务版本溢出
en: The task revision counter has overflowed.

zh: 任务编号重复，未创建任务
en: The task ID already exists. No task was created.

zh: 投递回执编号无效
en: The delivery receipt ID is invalid.

zh: 投递说明超过限制
en: The delivery explanation exceeds the size limit.

zh: 缺少已持久化的提交意图，不能把排队标为已提交
en: Submission intent has not been persisted. A queued task cannot be marked submitted.

zh: 请使用释放投递接口
en: Use the delivery release command.

zh: 没有编号 {id} 的任务
en: Collaboration task {id} was not found.

zh: 这条任务不是派给你的
en: This task is not assigned to you.

zh: 这条任务已经结了
en: This task has already been settled.

zh: 这条任务不在等确认
en: This task is not awaiting approval.

zh: 用户拒绝了这条派活
en: The user rejected this task assignment.

zh: 用户中止了协作
en: The user stopped collaboration.

zh: 目标会话已关闭
en: The target session was closed.

zh: 任务文件无效，已保留现场：{error}
en: The task file is invalid. The original data has been preserved: {error}

zh: 任务文件版本不支持，已按只读处理
en: This task file version is not supported. It has been opened read-only.

zh:
{message}
不要改用 belfry send 派房间任务，它不会写入房间任务板。恢复后先运行 belfry room status 核对，再拆解并创建任务。
en:
{message}
Do not switch to belfry send for room tasks; it does not update the room task board. After recovery, run belfry room status before creating tasks.

zh: 尚未收到任务状态，任务未完成确认。
en: No task status has been received. Completion is unconfirmed.

zh:
等了 {seconds} 秒它还没结。{latest}
要接着等就再敲一次 belfry wait。
en:
The task is still unsettled after {seconds} seconds. {latest}
Run belfry wait again to continue waiting.

zh:
任务未完成确认。{latest}
{error}
en:
Task completion is unconfirmed. {latest}
{error}

zh:
等了 {seconds} 秒它还没结。{status}
要接着等就再敲一次 belfry wait（不加 --timeout 就一直等）。
en:
The task is still unsettled after {seconds} seconds. {status}
Run belfry wait again to continue waiting (omit --timeout to wait indefinitely).

zh: {arg} 后面要跟一个值
en: {arg} requires a value.

zh: 不认识的参数 `{arg}`，用 belfry help 看看
en: Unknown option `{arg}`. Run belfry help for usage.

zh: --count 要是条数，收到的是 `{raw}`
en: --count requires a message count; received `{raw}`.

zh:
belfry room 后面要写 status、say、log、task 或 brief。

{usage}
en:
Expected status, say, log, task, or brief after belfry room.

{usage}

zh: belfry room say 要说点什么，比如：belfry room say @后端 接口定了吗
en: belfry room say requires a message, for example: belfry room say @backend Is the API ready?

zh: 要写任务号（比如 T1），用 belfry room status 看任务板
en: Specify a task ID such as T1. Run belfry room status to view the task board.

zh: belfry room task add 要写任务标题
en: belfry room task add requires a task title.

zh: belfry room task assign 要写交给谁：belfry room task assign T1 前端
en: belfry room task assign requires an assignee, for example: belfry room task assign T1 frontend

zh: belfry room task note 要写进展：belfry room task note T1 接口已联调
en: belfry room task note requires a progress update, for example: belfry room task note T1 API integration verified

zh: belfry room task 后面要写 add、start、done、assign、note、reopen 或 archive
en: Expected add, start, done, assign, note, reopen, or archive after belfry room task.

zh: --timeout 后面要跟秒数
en: --timeout requires a number of seconds.

zh: --timeout 要是秒数，收到的是 `{raw}`
en: --timeout requires a number of seconds; received `{raw}`.

zh: --timeout 至少 1 秒
en: --timeout must be at least 1 second.

zh: belfry wait 只等一条任务，多出来的是 `{arg}`
en: belfry wait accepts one task only; unexpected argument `{arg}`.

zh: belfry wait 需要任务号，用 belfry inbox 查
en: belfry wait requires a task ID. Run belfry inbox to find it.

zh: --parent 后面要跟任务号
en: --parent requires a task ID.

zh: belfry send 需要一个目标，用 belfry peers 看看有谁
en: belfry send requires a target. Run belfry peers to list sessions.

zh: belfry send 需要一条指令
en: belfry send requires an instruction.

zh: belfry done 需要任务号，用 belfry inbox 查
en: belfry done requires a task ID. Run belfry inbox to find it.

zh: belfry fail 需要任务号，用 belfry inbox 查
en: belfry fail requires a task ID. Run belfry inbox to find it.

zh: belfry fail 要说明原因：派活那边只能看到你写的这句
en: belfry fail requires a reason. The sender will see the explanation you provide.

zh: 这里不是 Belfry 的 Agent 会话（缺少身份信息），belfry 命令只在那里面能用
en: This is not a Belfry Agent session (identity information is missing). Run belfry inside a hosted Agent session.

zh: Belfry 的协作服务没有启动，这个会话没法和别的会话通信
en: The Belfry collaboration service is unavailable. This session cannot communicate with other sessions.

zh: 任务编号无效：房间操作请使用 belfry room 命令
en: Invalid task ID. Use belfry room commands for room operations.

zh: 应用未声明房间协议能力
en: The app did not advertise room protocol support.

zh: 请求序列化失败：{error}
en: Failed to serialize the request: {error}

zh: 请求超过 1 MiB 上限
en: The request exceeds the 1 MiB limit.

zh: 连不上 Belfry：{error}
en: Cannot connect to Belfry: {error}

en: Failed to send the request: {error}

zh: 没收到回应：{error}
en: No response received: {error}

zh: 回应超过 1 MiB 上限
en: The response exceeds the 1 MiB limit.

zh: 回应不完整，结果未知；请先查询状态，勿自动重复写入
en: The response is incomplete and the result is uncertain. Check the current status before retrying; do not automatically repeat writes.

zh: 回应看不懂：{error}
en: Invalid response: {error}

zh: 还等用户点头，没送出去
en: awaiting user approval; not delivered

zh: 已受理，尚未进入终端投递队列
en: accepted; not yet queued for terminal delivery

zh: 已排队，等对方空闲
en: queued; waiting for the recipient to become available

zh: 正在提交到终端，尚未收到提交回执
en: submitting to the terminal; no submission receipt yet

zh: 提交结果不确定，请核对目标终端；未自动重复投递
en: submission uncertain; check the target terminal; no automatic resubmission

zh: 投递已取消
en: delivery cancelled

zh: 已送到对方终端，它还没交差
en: submitted to the recipient terminal; no completion report yet

zh: 对方说做不了
en: the recipient reported that it cannot complete the task

zh: 已作废（对方会话没了或被中止）
en: abandoned (the recipient session ended or was stopped)

zh: ← 等你回复
en: <- reply required

en: unassigned

en: waiting for {tasks} to finish

en: Completion criteria: {outcome}

zh: 结果：{result}
en: Result: {result}

zh: 最近进展：{last}
en: Latest progress: {last}

en: Room "{room}"; I am {role} "{title}"

zh: 需求简报
en: Brief
(me)

zh: 任务板是空的。拆活：belfry room task add <标题> --to <角色>
en: The task board is empty. Assign work with: belfry room task add <title> --to <role>

zh: 任务板是空的，等统筹派活。
en: The task board is empty. Wait for the coordinator to assign work.

zh: 任务板
en: Task board

zh: 等你回复（belfry room say --reply <id> <话>）
en: Replies required (belfry room say --reply <id> <text>)

zh: 现在没有别的会话
en: There are no other sessions.

zh: (未命名)
en: (unnamed)

zh: （我自己）
en: (my session)

zh: 要派活得先在侧栏给它起个名字
en: name this session in the sidebar before assigning work

zh: {activity} · 可以派活
en: {activity} - available for assignments

zh: {activity} · 现在收不了
en: {activity} - unavailable

zh: 你不在任何协作房间里。房间由用户在界面上搭好，把你拉进去之后才用得上 belfry room。
en: You are not in any collaboration rooms. The user creates rooms in the app and adds sessions; then you can use belfry room.

zh: 房间「{room}」：我是{role}「{title}」
en: Room "{room}": I am {role} "{title}"

zh: 职责：{duty}
en: Responsibilities: {duty}

zh: 统筹：{coordinator}
en: Coordinator: {coordinator}

zh: 还没定
en: not assigned

zh: 目标：{objective}
en: Objective: {objective}

zh: 没完成的任务 {tasks} 条；等我回复的消息 {replies} 条
en: Open tasks: {tasks}; replies required: {replies}

zh: 全貌用 belfry room status。
en: Run belfry room status for the full picture.

zh: 已发到房间「{room}」[{message}]，收件人：{recipients}。
en: Saved to room "{room}" [{message}], recipients: {recipients}. Terminal delivery is pending.

zh: 对方回复之前会一直挂着「等你回复」。
en: The reply request stays open until each recipient responds.

zh: 房间「{room}」还没有消息。
en: Room "{room}" has no messages yet.

zh: 房间「{room}」最近的对话（回复某条：belfry room say --reply <id> <话>）：
en: Recent messages in room "{room}" (reply with belfry room say --reply <id> <text>):

zh:
房间「{room}」的需求简报已更新，成员都会收到通知。
{brief}
en:
The brief for room "{room}" was updated. Notifications are queued for members.
{brief}

en: Task {task} was proposed for "{to}". Delivery requires user approval.

en: Task {task} was accepted for "{to}" and is awaiting delivery. It will be submitted when the target is available; acceptance does not mean work has started.

en: Task {task} has been settled.

en: Task {task}: {state}

en: No tasks have been assigned to you.

{id}  来自 {sender}  [{state}]
    {instruction}

{id}  from {sender}  [{state}]
    {instruction}

zh: 要指定派给谁
en: Specify a target session.

en: The session registry is unavailable.

en: Multiple sessions are named "{query}". Give them unique names in the sidebar first.

en: No other sessions can receive assignments right now.

en: No session is named "{query}".

en: Available sessions: {sessions}.

en: The room was paused or deleted. Automatic delivery has stopped.

en: The message ledger is not a regular file.

en: The message ledger is shorter than its committed offset.

en: Cannot write message ledger {path}: {error}

en: The attachment does not contain binary data.

en: Assignment rules: match the task objective to responsibilities first, then consider workload, session activity and dependencies among matching members. Being idle is not a reason to assign work. Use the task board, and check current responsibilities and existing tasks with belfry room status before assigning to avoid duplicates.

en: task add --to / task assign accepts a current role name or full member ID. Names can be reused; never replace an invalid former member ID with a newcomer using the same name.

zh: 「{title}」职责更新为：{duty}。现有任务负责人保持不变，下一次派活请按最新职责判断。
en: Responsibilities for "{title}" are now: {duty}. Existing task owners are unchanged; use the current responsibilities for the next assignment.

zh: 「{title}」已绑定新的会话，成员身份和任务不变。
en: "{title}" is attached to a new session; member identity and tasks are unchanged.

zh: 「{title}」（成员ID：{member_id}）离开了房间。
en: "{title}" (member ID: {member_id}) left the room.

zh: {prefix}「{members}」手上没有任务，房间已经安静 {minutes} 分钟。请先核对剩余目标与成员职责；只向职责匹配者分派，空闲不代表适合。没有后续工作就不用回复。
en: {prefix}"{members}" have no tasks and the room has been quiet for {minutes} minutes. Check the remaining objective and member responsibilities first; assign only to matching members. Being idle does not mean being suitable. No reply is needed when there is no further work.

zh: 无
en: None

zh: 未分配
en: Unassigned

zh: 你是统筹：你的主要工作是协调，不是自己动手。收到需求先看 belfry room status，把需求拆成任务、按职责派给成员（belfry room task add <标题> --to <角色> --outcome <完成标准>）；只有很小的活、或者没有合适的成员时才自己做。派活只用任务板，不要用 belfry send。房间命令报错时向用户报告原始错误，先核对任务板；不要绕过任务板派活或重复创建。成员完成任务或空闲通知用于核对进度，下一项仍须先匹配最新职责；全部完成后用 belfry room say --to @用户 汇报。
en: You are the coordinator: your main job is coordination. Read belfry room status when a request arrives, split work into tasks and assign by responsibility (belfry room task add <title> --to <role> --outcome <acceptance criteria>). Do work yourself only when it is small or no member fits. Use the task board, not belfry send. If a room command fails, report the original error to the user and check the board; do not bypass it or create duplicates. Completion and idle notices are progress signals; the next assignment must still match current responsibilities. When all work is complete, report with belfry room say --to @user.
